description: The Prusa CORE One is a fully enclosed CoreXY FDM 3D printer from Prusa Research. Its chamber heats up to 55 °C, so it can print everyday filaments like PLA and PETG as well as engineering materials. In a makerspace, students use it to print prototypes, enclosures, replacement parts and functional mechanical parts up to 250 × 220 × 270 mm.

specs.label: Nozzle
specs.value: High-flow Prusa Nozzle brass CHT – 0.4 mm

specs.label: Supported materials
specs.value: PLA, PETG, Flex, PVA, PC, PP, CPE, PVB; with Advanced Filtration System: ABS, ASA, HIPS, PA

specs.label: Print surface
specs.value: Magnetic heatbed with removable PEI spring steel sheets

ppeRequired: Heat-resistant gloves when handling hot parts
useRestrictions: Only trained users may operate it, and ABS, ASA, HIPS or nylon may be printed only when the Advanced Filtration System is fitted.
